scope: Two separate environments, 96 retained timing calls and 20 workload cells; no source changes, gate waiver or cross-environment subtraction. Earlier timing records remain valid at their own pins/settings.

definitions.rates: Arithmetic means and observed min/max from two processes per arm/cell, with one measured repeat after warmup. These are not confidence intervals.
definitions.deltas: 100*(candidate/reference-1), paired forward and reverse; positive is faster. Windows has main and mx comparisons; Linux has mx only.
definitions.decode: Every phase resets history. Decode starts empty; it is not continuation of the measured prompt. Context-dependent configurations remain separate.
definitions.allocation: Reference context=max(512,p,n); llmx model logical context and lazy reached-block Vulkan allocation. Equal token streams/reach do not imply equal allocated KV layouts.
definitions.limits: Default runtime policies are compared; no claim of identical internal arithmetic, latest-main qualification, a layout band or universal parity.

settings.order: 24 forward calls then exact whole-order reverse

reference.required_recheck: actual F32-KV Vulkan adapter source/hash, linked libraries and --list-devices; do not substitute CPU or default-f16-KV wrapper

activity.sample_count_note: Per-call and per-arm sample observations can overlap at process boundaries; do not sum them as unique global samples.

thresholds.unknown: Missing counters, inaccessible/new process deltas and invalid samples are unknown, never zero

clocks.limitation: Existing Windows telemetry has no clock/tuning-policy witness

interpretation: All 48 calls are retained. Six of eight main/candidate prefill cells change sign between forward and reverse. Q4_0 pp64 is positive in both (+0.205/+0.582 percent); Q4_K_M pp4096 is positive in both (+0.093/+0.233 percent). These small differences do not establish a speedup or a layout band.

Decode Q4_0 in the pp512/tg32 setting is slower in both directions (-2.589/-0.803 percent). That observed loss is retained, not discarded or declared disproved. Its attribution is unresolved with two observations, background activity and no matched layout perturbation.

Decode Q4_K_M in the pp64/tg128 and pp247/tg32 settings is positive in both directions (+0.683/+0.040 and +2.159/+0.978 percent). The other five decode cells change sign. Gains and losses are reported together; there is no universal nonregression claim.

Candidate and main both exceed the pinned mx rates in every observed phase and direction for these two 0.6B existing-quant models. This is a default-runtime screen in one Windows environment, not a claim for other models/types or identical arithmetic.

Every call has unrelated CPU flags and at least one unknown process/counter observation. GPU flags occur in 37 calls and identify only System/PID4, which does not establish a competing user GPU workload. No disk-busy or disk-rate threshold fires.

Decode resets history independently of prefill in each runtime. Prompt/decode labels identify one configuration, not generation after that prompt. Reference allocated context is max(512,p,n); llmx logical context is 40960 with lazy reached-block backing. Allocated KV layouts differ, so decode rates across prompt configurations must remain separate.
limitations: Two processes per model/phase/arm only, one measured repeat each. No small-difference or layout-control claim.
Both runtimes use samepinnedfile/device/F32KV. Reference inputembedding may remain host-owned; require alltransformer/output andKVlayersVulkan.
Monitor process windows include loads/warmups, not exact kernel phase timestamps.
Separate decode configurations retain context andtokencount; never aggregate across them.
Reference allocation floors context512; llmx retains the model logical context and lazily backs reached64-token Vulkan blocks. Token streams/high-water reach match; allocated KV layouts do not.
ABBA or forward/reverse is a bounded timing screen, not a layout-control result or exact nonregression proof.
The pinned f223/e984 arithmetic comparison remains separate from later scheduler-only integration.
Sampled intervals may miss short-lived processes; inaccessible/new processes have unknown CPU deltas; GPU engine values are not additive.
Disk counters are aggregate and cannot assign activity to the benchmark or background processes.
Samples spanning a process boundary may count in both adjacent calls; no sample was discarded.

settings.token_streams: Same uint32 LCG 1664525*x+1013904223, modulo min(1000,vocab), seeds12345 prompt and777 decode.
settings.phase_scope: Each phase resets history first; decode starts empty and is not continuation after the measured prompt. One warmup of each phase precedes r1 measured work.
settings.context: Reference max(512,p,n); llmx model logical context with lazy backing and max(p,n) token reach. Allocation policies differ.
settings.reference_policy: Pinned eefc4e Vulkan wrapper, automatic flash attention, full transformer/output and KV offload; embedding placement follows its existing policy.

coverage.monitor_exit_limit: The runner waited for the monitor, but did not save its return code. Stop record and empty log do not prove exit code zero.

limitations: Short-lived processes between samples may be missed; disappeared/new and inaccessible processes are retained as coverage limits. Unavailable GPU counters are not zero.
Two process measurements per arm/workload. r1 SD0 does not estimate repeatability; ranges and paired signs are retained.
All calls and activity retained; flags do not imply causation or automatic rejection.
Whole-call activity and resource counters include load, warmup and both phases; no phase-specific attribution.
Boundary samples can belong to adjacent calls; per-call counts must not be summed as unique observations.
No same-owner layout control, latest-main comparison, correctness proof or universal parity claim.
Windows six-thread measurements are a separate environment; do not subtract them from this Linux four-thread screen.
